_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Reads the field definitions each collection's posts use, so the model fills meta.custom correctly.

description: Read the site's collection field definitions (`_data/collections.json`, draft view): { schema: { v: 1, collections: { "<key>": { fields[], settings? } } }, hash }. hash is null when no schema exists yet — pass it as put_collection_schema ifMatch. 409 collection_schema_invalid { hash, issues } means the stored file is broken: fix it with put_collection_schema using that hash.

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

name: get_collection_schema
